title: Count Vowel Substrings of a String
summary: Define a substring as a continuous sequence of characters within a string.
statement: Define a substring as a continuous sequence of characters within a string. A vowel substring consists solely of the vowels 'a', 'e', 'i', 'o', and 'u', and must include all five vowels. Given a string, count the number of such vowel substrings.
constraints: A qualifying substring is contiguous, contains only vowels, and contains all five vowel types.
Return the number of qualifying substrings.
hints: Consonants divide the string into independent vowel-only segments.
For every left endpoint, extend right until a consonant while tracking distinct vowels, counting once all five appear.
Break on nonvowel; add vowel to seen; count when len(seen)==5.
Every vowel-only substring is visited at its unique endpoints, and the seen-set condition is equivalent to containing all required vowel types.
editorial: Every vowel-only substring is visited at its unique endpoints, and the seen-set condition is equivalent to containing all required vowel types.

tests.explanation: The substrings aeiou and aeiouu both contain all vowels and no consonant.
No vowel-only segment contains all five vowel types.
